title: Prevent applyFieldOverrides from mutating shared field configs in nested frames
answers: Why does a panel using the Dashboard datasource inherit field display names or units from another panel?
Why are field overrides leaking into raw query results from Time series to table?
How to prevent applyFieldOverrides from mutating shared source DataFrame configurations?
body:
Symptom: Downstream panels consuming queries via the -- Dashboard -- datasource inherit unexpected display names, units, colors, or thresholds from an upstream table panel.
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/field/fieldOverrides.ts:applyFieldOverrides merged nested frame field configurations in-place with defaultsDeep, mutating shared query field objects.
Fix pattern: Deep-clone field configs before merging with defaultsDeep (defaultsDeep(cloneDeep(valueField.config) || {}, config)) and return new frame and field copies.
Constraints: Applies when processing nested frames (FieldType.frame) sharing field references; shallow copying is insufficient because defaultsDeep mutates nested objects like custom and thresholds.
applies: packages/grafana-data field override processing for nested DataFrame fields (FieldType.frame)
